objective: I can test our pump at two heights and use the flow rate to judge it against our criteria.
standard: HS-ETS1-3 — judge a design against criteria and trade-offs

sections.es: Desayuno y para empezar

sections.prompt: In Science 1.6 you named one thing that could go wrong with our build. What was it? What would we see if it happened?
sections.es: ¿Qué podría salir mal? ¿Qué veríamos?
stems: One thing that could go wrong is ______.

sections.es: ¿Llegará arriba?

sections.label: Key words
sections.text: Our **criteria** are what the build must do. Water reaches the top channel. At least 1 liter comes out each minute. A **system** is parts that work together: tote, pump, tubing, channels.
sections.es: Criterios: lo que debe lograr. Sistema: partes que trabajan juntas.

sections.text: The pump sits on the bottom of the tote. The top channel is about 120 cm above it.

sections.prompt: Predict: will the top channel get more water than the bottom channel, the same, or less? Circle one.
sections.es: Predice: ¿arriba sale más, igual o menos agua?

sections.prompt: Draw how water gets from the tote to the top channel. Draw the path with arrows. Label each part.
sections.es: Dibuja el camino del agua con flechas.
Construye y prueba

sections.label: Build it
items: Set the pump flat on the bottom of the tote.
Push the tubing all the way onto the pump.
Check: the pump is under water.
Plug in only at the safety outlet.
sections.es: Arma la bomba paso a paso.

sections.label: Key word
sections.text: **Flow rate** is how much water comes out in one minute.
sections.es: Caudal: el agua que sale en un minuto.

sections.prompt: Hold the end of the tube at each channel. Time how long it takes to fill a 1-liter bottle. Then find the flow rate.
sections.es: Mide el tiempo para llenar 1 litro. Calcula el caudal.
sections.example: 40 seconds to fill 1 liter: 60 ÷ 40 = 1.5 liters a minute

sections.es: Pensemos juntos

sections.prompt: Talk with your partner. Compare the two flow rates. Why do you think they are different?
sections.es: Compara los dos caudales. ¿Por qué son diferentes?
stems: The top got ______ liters a minute. The bottom got ______.
I think they are different because ______.

sections.prompt: Does our pump meet our criteria? Circle one.
sections.es: ¿La bomba cumple los criterios? Encierra uno.
stems: At the top it moved ______ liters a minute, so ______.

sections.es: Nómbralo y mira

sections.label: Key word
sections.text: To **prime** a pump is to fill it with water and push the air out, so it can move water.
sections.es: Cebar: llenar la bomba de agua y sacar el aire.

sections.prompt: Watch the video. How do they **prime** the pump? What do they do first?
sections.es: ¿Cómo ceban la bomba? ¿Qué hacen primero?

sections.text: If the top gets too little water, we have two fixes. A stronger pump costs more and is louder. A lower top channel leaves room for fewer plants.

sections.es: Dibújalo otra vez

sections.prompt: Draw it again. Show how, not only what: why does less water reach the top? Use a thick arrow for more flow and a thin arrow for less.
sections.es: Dibuja otra vez: ¿por qué llega menos agua arriba?
Cierre

sections.label: Words you can use
sections.es: Palabras que puedes usar

sections.prompt: Which fix would make our system better: a stronger pump or a lower top channel? Use a number from today's test.
sections.es: ¿Qué arreglo eliges? Usa un número de la prueba.

stems.evidence: At the top channel, the flow rate was ______ liters a minute.
stems.reasoning: In a system, when the water has to go higher, the pump ______, so ______.

sections.prompt: How ready is our system for plants? Circle one. Then say why.
sections.es: ¿Qué tan listo está el sistema? Encierra uno y explica.
